card_reads.read: Ranks #1 in our power figure blend; model 44% vs 39% morning-line implied (+5.8 pts)
card_reads.shape: No one horse is entitled to the lead going over a mile and three sixteenths on turf in a $110,000 allowance optional claimer. No pace adjustment applied.
